conditions: You can have only one adversary at a time. Clear or convert any Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: Oull
rows.alt: when you land the full correct sequence, 25% to drop

conditions: A Kuva Flood always drops an Eterna Relic, and each of your Sister's Hounds has a 5% chance to drop a Requiem Relic.
Open them in a Requiem Fissure on the Kuva Fortress. They cannot be refined with Void Traces and hold only the eight Requiem mods, never Oull.
Each solved sequence uses one charge from every equipped mod. A mod with no charges is Defiled and unusable.
Palladino sells the retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, 10 per week of each.

disclosures.title: stock mods before the Sister spawns
disclosures.body: A Sister stays until you solve her sequence, so have a pool of Requiem mods ready before you Mercy a Candidate.

groups.activity: open the Nightmare Granum Void and inspect Sister Candidates
groups.meta: at most 11 Candidates to land a chosen weapon

rows.label: Tenet Plinx Candidate
rows.note: weapon preview must say Tenet Plinx

rows.label: progenitor of choice
rows.note: its element becomes the weapon's bonus damage and sets the Sister's abilities
rows.alt: Elemental Vice swaps the element later at rank 40

conditions: Kill the Treasurer when it appears. Spend the Crown at a Golden Hand Tribute, then kill 25 Errant Specters (25 more per extra squadmate) for Nightmare Rank 1. A Candidate then appears on the Corpus Ship.
Stand near the downed Candidate to see her weapon. If it is not the Plinx, leave her and finish the mission.
Only the last player to damage her can Mercy her, so run solo. You cannot Mercy while any Lich, Sister, or Coda is active. A Candidate can flee, so catch her first.

disclosures.title: the only reliable weapon reroll
disclosures.body: Finishing the mission without Mercy puts that weapon on a reject list, so it will not show again until every weapon has appeared. Skip every Candidate that is not the one you want.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal mods, and test the sequence
groups.meta: reveal all 3 Requiems, then find their order

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal the mods, not their order

rows.label: correct Parazon sequence
rows.note: sends the Sister to Neptune Proxima

conditions: Mercy Hounds on your Sister's nodes. Each one adds a Murmur and fills her rage meter.
Do not stab your Sister until one Requiem is revealed. After that, equip the known mods on your Parazon and stab every time she is down.
A wrong stab stops at the first wrong mod, ranks the Sister up (Venus, Phobos, Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto), and gives the squad 10 Murmurs.
Kill her Hound before her health runs out; a Hound alive at that point self-destructs and gives no Murmur.
Each node under her influence takes about 0.7% of your mission credits. You get it all back when she is defeated.
Let her stumble three times without stabbing and she leaves without ranking up.
bonuses: Each stab makes her drop 7,000 to 10,000 credits.
A Requiem Ultimatum forces your Sister out on one of her nodes. Palladino sells one a week for 10 Riven Slivers; use it solo, since a squad can spawn a teammate's Sister instead.

disclosures.title: the safe four-stab routine
disclosures.body: Put the first revealed Requiem in slot 1 with any two others behind it. If the stab fails, move it to slot 2, then slot 3. Put each later reveal in the first slot not ruled out. The fourth stab is guaranteed.

disclosures.title: the same routine with Oull
disclosures.body: Put Oull in slot 1 and the first known Requiem in slot 2; swap them if it fails. If the known one failed slot 1, move it to slot 3. Put the second reveal in the first unknown slot, and move it to slot 2 if it fails. The last stab fixes the order. Replace Oull with the third reveal once you have it.

groups.activity: Railjack Skirmish; defeat the Sister and Vanquish her

rows.label: Tenet Plinx
rows.note: ready to claim in the Foundry

conditions: Clear the crewships and Security Nodes, board her ship, kill her Hound and two Warframe Specters, then beat her single health bar.
Choose Vanquish, never Convert. No choice within 20 seconds Vanquishes.
The weapon ignores its normal Mastery Rank requirement.
bonuses: Everything she taxed comes back, every squad member gets a Corrupted Holokey, and a vanquish has a 25% chance to drop a Requiem Ultimatum.
If she carries an Ephemera you get it. Vanquishing also gives you her Hound.
An unclaimed Tenet weapon in the Foundry sells for 10,000 credits.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.note: optional; the bonus rolls between 25% and 60%
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Fusion gives 1.1 times the higher bonus, rounded down and capped at 60%. A result of 58% or more becomes 60%, so a donor at 52.8% or better finishes it.

Start from the Tenet Plinx you want to keep. Its Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapter, Focus lens, and Elemental Vice stay; the donor's are lost. Claim the donor from the Foundry first, since unclaimed copies cannot be fused.
Elemental Vice swaps the bonus element only on a rank 40 weapon (5 Forma). It does not change the percentage.
bonuses: Fusion lets you pick which of the two elements survives.
